name_en: Sukikonbu no nimono — shredded kelp simmered with mushroom and carrot
summary_ja: 若い昆布を茹でて細く切り乾燥させた「すき昆布」を水で戻し、にんじんや干ししいたけと醤油味で煮る。昭和44年頃に普代村で養殖と加工が始まり、県内全域の家庭料理として定着した保存食である。
summary_en: Young kelp, boiled, shredded and dried into "suki-konbu," is rehydrated and simmered with carrot and dried shiitake in soy sauce — a preserve that spread statewide after kelp farming began in Fudai village around 1969.
source_title: すき昆布の煮物 岩手県

name_en: Nishime — a soy-simmered assembly of seared tofu, root vegetables and dried mountain greens
summary_ja: 焼き目をつけた豆腐や人参、こんにゃく、山菜、身欠きにしんを醤油とだしで煮る。冠婚葬祭や正月、盆に県内全域で作られる持ち寄り料理で、内陸部と沿岸部で使う乾物・干し魚が異なる。
summary_en: Seared tofu, carrot, konjac, dried mountain greens and herring are simmered together in soy-seasoned dashi — a potluck dish made statewide for weddings, funerals, New Year and Obon, with dried goods varying between inland and coastal Iwate.

name_en: Ukogi no horohoro — a savory topping of hedge-shrub greens, pickled daikon and walnut
summary_ja: 生垣にも使われる「うこぎ」の若芽を茹でて刻み、味噌漬け大根とくるみを合わせてふりかけ状にする。かつて凶作時の救荒食材だったうこぎを活かす盛岡周辺の春の料理で、ご飯にのせて食べる。
summary_en: Blanched, chopped young shoots of the hedge shrub ukogi are mixed with miso-pickled daikon and walnut into a savory topping — a spring dish from around Morioka that makes use of a plant once relied on in famine years, eaten spooned over rice.
source_title: うこぎのほろほろ 岩手県

name_en: Kurumi tofu — a walnut and kudzu jelly served as a meat-free sashimi substitute
summary_ja: すって漉いたくるみに砂糖とくず粉を加えて練り、固めて刺身の代わりに切り分ける。奥州市江刺地方の精進料理で、味噌としょうが汁を合わせた甘めのたれをかけて食べる。地元でとれる鬼ぐるみを使う。
summary_en: Ground, strained walnut is thickened with sugar and kudzu starch, set firm and sliced in place of raw fish — a shojin dish from Oshu's Esashi area, served with a sweet miso-and-ginger sauce, made with local "oni-gurumi" walnuts.
source_title: くるみ豆腐 岩手県
